items.scope: All projects listed at https://openjsf.org/projects.
Bosch products only.
Yandex issues only.
JetBrains products only.
Zyxel products issues only.

All products released by Teradyne Robotics subsidiaries, Universal Robots (UR) and Mobile Industrial Robots (MiR), including both actively supported and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software identified by Teradyne Robotics that are outside the scope of another CNA.
Vulnerabilities in software discovered by NCSC-FI, and vulnerabilities reported to NCSC-FI for coordinated disclosure, which are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities for OTRS and ((OTRS)) Community Edition and modules only.

Vulnerabilities in Protect AI products, third-party code vulnerabilities reported by researchers collaborating with huntr and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Protect AI that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All ConnectWise products and services and vulnerabilities discovered by ConnectWise in third party products that are not within another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in any Google Cloud developed product and not under the scope of another CNA.
Caliptra Project components and vulnerabilities that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Samsung Mobile Galaxy products, personal computers, and related services only.
Projects listed on its Alibaba GitHub website only.
All automotive and related infrastructure vulnerabilities that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities discovered in Extreme Networks, Inc.’s products and services.
Vulnerabilities in PHP code (code in https://github.com/php/php-src) only.
N-able branded products and technologies only.
Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.

Any Seagate or LaCie software or hardware, open or closed source, supported and end of life, as well as any vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Seagate that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Qualcomm and Snapdragon issues only.
openGauss issues only.
Vulnerabilities in vendor products discovered by BLSOPS, or related parties, while performing vulnerability research or security assessments, unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
All Arista products only.
All Cato Networks products and vulnerabilities in third-party products affecting Cato products unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
All EnterpriseDB products and vulnerabilities identified in open source libraries used by EnterpriseDB products unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
All HashiCorp products and projects unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
ABB issues only.
Projects within The Document Foundation only, e.g., LibreOffice, LibreOffice Online; The Document Foundation discourages reporting denial of service bugs as security issues.
Vulnerabilities in Intigriti products and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Intigriti that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Supported Secomea products only.
Digi branded products and services only.
StrongDM issues only.
All upKeeper Solutions products, excluding end-of-life (EOL) as listed in the upKeeper Solutions End of Life Policy.
All Rockwell Automation products.
Vulnerabilities in the following Altium products only: Altium Designer, A365, Octopart, and Altium Enterprise Server.
Vulnerabilities discovered by SRA that are not within the scope of another CNA.
NEC issues only.
Bizerba products only.
Zoom and Keybase issues only.
Kubernetes issues only.

All products of Medtronic or a Medtronic company including supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered in Medtronic products that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Intel branded products and technologies and Intel managed open source projects.
Vulnerabilities discovered by, reported to, or coordinated by, SCHUTZWERK unless covered by another CNA.
Vulnerabilities in linqi products only.
Concrete CMS Core versions 8.5 and above.
Xerox Corporation issues only.
Gridware software, services, and infrastructure issues, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by or reported to Gridware researchers that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All BlackBerry products identified on https://www.blackberry.com/us/en.
All OpenText products (including Carbonite, Zix, Micro Focus, others).
